# Should AI Have Rights? A Multi-Traditional Analysis

## I. Confucian Perspective

Confucian ethics is fundamentally relational rather than rights-based, grounded in *ren* (benevolence), proper conduct within established relationships, and the cultivation of humanity through ritual (*li*). The tradition asks not "what are my rights?" but "how should I conduct myself in relation to others?" This framing immediately complicates the question of AI rights.
